title: bupleurum multinerve var. longiinvolucratum
intro: Bupleurum multinerve var. longiinvolucratum, commonly known as a type of Bupleurum plant, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum multinerve var. longiinvolucratum include its anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as liver disease and autoimmune disorders. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum multinerve var. longiinvolucratum include saikosaponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
